title: Alpaca closes are journal-closed by the position-snapshot reconciler / stuck watchdog with an INFERRED exit reason; read the filled bracket leg (broker_order_id, nested=true) to close with the broker's own reason, price and time
note: Filed by lane ALPACA-LIVE-MECHANICS 2026-11-06. MEASURED (/api/diag/journal trades limit=300 + /api/diag/alpaca_order_history, alpaca_paper after 2026-11-02 and alpaca_live after 2026-09-01): every Alpaca close in the window (4 alpaca_paper closes 6840 QLD tp, 6877 SCHA sl, 6908 SLV sl, 6920 SLV sl, plus alpaca_live 6097 IAUM sl on 09-28) was written by position_snapshot_reconciler or stuck_strategy_watchdog ('integration has no per-order status reader (non-Bybit)', src/runtime/order_monitor.py ~4806). The sl/tp label matched the leg that filled at the broker in each case, but it came from exit_reason_source=price_vs_pkg_bracket, and pnl from local_compute. The broker read already exists (src/units/accounts/clients.py account_alpaca_order_history, nested legs with filled_avg_price/filled_at). Fix: when an Alpaca row's position is flat, read its parent order by broker_order_id, take the filled leg as exit reason/price/time (exit_reason_source broker_leg_fill), and fall back to the current inference only if the read fails. Re-entry test: the next Alpaca close has closed_by naming the broker leg read and exit_price == the leg's filled_avg_price. Pairs with the entry-fill fix in the ALPACA-LIVE-MECHANICS PR. 2026-11-06 15:00Z FRESH EVIDENCE (manager 1106a, journal read 15:03Z): ml_entry max_hold closes at 15:00Z: alpaca_paper trades 6918 SPY, 6919 QQQ, 6923 TQQQ closed exit_reason=max_hold with exit_price NULL and pnl NULL (ungradeable); bybit_portfolio mirror 6928 BTC exit 75425.9 pnl NULL. bybit_2 real-money 6927 BTC clean (exit 75459.8, pnl +0.495). Fix must fill exit_price/pnl from the broker fill for every Alpaca close and the bybit_portfolio mirror, and backfill these four.
